newsitem.title: CHINA: More foreign finance bodies do business in China.
newsitem.headline: More foreign finance bodies do business in China.

text.p: A total of 158 foreign financial institutions are now doing business in China, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.

There are 132 foreign bank branches, seven Sino-foreign joint venture banks, five solely foreign-invested banks, five foreign or joint venture finance companies, eight insurance firms and one Sino-foreign joint venture investment bank, the newspaper quoted a report by the central bank as saying.
Among them, nine foreign bank branches have been given approval to do local Chinese yuan business.
A total of 528 other foreign financial institutions have set up representative offices in China, the newspaper quoted the report by the People's Bank of China as saying.
